description.value: Caffè W has been serving the West Broadway neighbourhood since 1995, making it one of Vancouver's longer-running independent cafés. The menu ranges from classic espresso drinks and specialty lattes to smoothies, frappes, and a full brunch lineup. The café is known for its exclusive 'Dubai Chocolate' creations — a pistachio-and-chocolate dessert series not found elsewhere — and a rotating display of artisan pastries.
